verdict.rationale: Phoenix's docs describe LLM-as-a-judge evaluators in which a second model scores outputs against a rubric. These evaluators can be configured in the UI and attached to datasets for automatic scoring. Judge models are swappable via adapters, explanations are returned by default, and evals can run on production traces, experiment results or datasets, with full capture of judge prompts and reasoning. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of evaluator configuration (e.g. custom rubric/template editing) beyond first-party docs.
